contexts.text: Into their secret let not my soul come () = that spiritual good does not want to know the evils which are of their will... Not to come into the secret = not to want to know. AE 443:end.
That they might solve the secret concerning the origin of conjugial love... CL 103:3.
The cupidity of divulging the secrets of the house (a cause of lawful separation). CL 472.
In the New Church it is allowable to enter and penetrate with the understanding into all its secrets, and to confirm them by the Word.
(The Quakers have) a species of secret deceit.
